clue.text: One taking steps to air grievance in public

definitions.text: One taking steps to air grievance in public

parts.words: One taking steps to air grievance in public
parts.note: surface reading: someone who takes action, such as complaining openly, to get a wrong put right
setter's reading: literally walking, in a crowd through the streets, carrying a placard

explanation.walkthrough: 'Taking steps' usually means taking measures; here it means literal footsteps in a street demonstration.
explanation.definitionFit: A demonstrator walking in a public procession is literally stepping along while voicing a shared complaint.

clue.text: Plug green commercial

definitions.note: used as a noun: a broadcast advertisement

parts.note: a plug is a bit of publicity, an ad
vert is the heraldic word for green

explanation.surface: Promote an environmentally friendly TV spot.
explanation.walkthrough: Vert is the colour green in heraldry; 'commercial' looks like an adjective but is the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A commercial is a paid broadcast notice promoting a product, which is exactly an advertisement.

clue.text: Musical instrument incomplete

indicators.note: something incomplete is missing a part, here its final letter

parts.note: a harmonica is a mouth organ, a small instrument

explanation.surface: Someone complains that a musical instrument is missing a part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Musical instrument' reads as one phrase, but 'Musical' alone is the definition, an adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Harmonic is an adjective relating to harmony, so it means pertaining to music or tuneful.

clue.text: Fruit in the scones Ruth cooked!

indicators.note: cooking transforms ingredients, so these letters are mixed into a new order

parts.note: the letters of these three words, taken as written

explanation.surface: Ruth has baked scones with some fruit in them.
explanation.walkthrough: A conker is no fruit for a scone, hence the exclamation mark.
explanation.definitionFit: The conker is the seed-bearing fruit of a large tree, botanically counted as a nut and so a fruit.

clue.text: Advanced celebrity houses left burning

parts.note: A is a standard abbreviation for advanced, as in A-level

indicators.note: to house something is to hold it inside, so one piece sits within another

parts.note: celebrity is the state of being famous
L is the usual abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: An up-and-coming star's home is abandoned while on fire.
explanation.definitionFit: Something on fire is ablaze, alight, in flames, which this adjective describes.

clue.text: Leading tribesman entered Bairiki travelling round this country

indicators.note: to enter is to go inside, so one letter is placed within the other group
travelling round suggests moving about, so the place name's letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written; Bairiki is an islet in the Pacific

indicators.note: leading picks out what comes first, the initial letter of the following word

parts.note: the first letter of tribesman

explanation.surface: A tribal chief arrived in Bairiki on a tour of this nation.
explanation.walkthrough: Bairiki is the seat of government on Tarawa atoll, so the surface is apt: the tribesman is touring the very country the answer names.
explanation.definitionFit: This Pacific island nation has its government seated on Bairiki, so the clue points to it as this country.

clue.text: Warmer part of an engine?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a domestic heater fixed to a wall
second meaning: the car component that cools the engine coolant

explanation.walkthrough: 'Warmer' looks like a comparative adjective but is a noun, something that warms a room; the question mark admits the irony that the car part cools.
explanation.definitionFit: The same word names a room heater and the cooling unit at the front of a car.

clue.text: Continent where temperance organisation includes father, I see

indicators.note: includes means holds within, so the organisation's letters wrap around the rest

parts.note: AA is Alcoholics Anonymous, whose members abstain from drink
Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest's title
I plus C, which sounds like see

explanation.surface: A sober group abroad welcomes a priest, someone remarks.
explanation.walkthrough: C is often clued by 'see' or 'sea' since it is the letter's name said aloud.
explanation.definitionFit: Africa is one of the seven great landmasses of the world.

clue.text: Fibrous cord contained shell disintegrating

indicators.note: something disintegrating falls apart, so these letters break up and reform

parts.note: the letters of these two words, taken as written

explanation.surface: A tough cord held inside a casing that is crumbling.
explanation.definitionFit: This band of tough connective tissue links the calf muscles to the heel bone.

clue.text: One who finds things hard to grasp

definitions.text: One who finds things hard to grasp

parts.words: One who finds things hard to grasp
parts.note: surface reading: a slow learner who struggles to understand ideas
setter's reading: grasp is physical, someone clumsy who keeps dropping objects

explanation.walkthrough: 'Grasp' usually means understand; here it means literally hold in the hand.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a jokey name for a clumsy person whose hands seem too slippery, always dropping objects.

clue.text: Heating unit hospital needed in time

indicators.note: needed in places one piece inside the other, which holds it

parts.note: a term is a fixed period of time
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

explanation.surface: A hospital urgently needs heating installed soon.
explanation.definitionFit: A therm is a measure of heat energy, used by British gas suppliers for billing.

clue.text: Having removed his masque is easily nauseated

indicators.note: removed here means moved again, so the letters are moved into a new arrangement

parts.note: the letters of these two words, taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone at a masked ball takes off the mask and feels queasy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Removed' reads as taken off, but it is re-moved: moved about.
explanation.definitionFit: A squeamish person is quickly made to feel sick or faint, for example by blood.

clue.text: Did not stand heartless antic that was wicked

indicators.note: heartless means without a heart, so the middle letter of the word goes

parts.note: if you did not stand you sat
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone remained seated through a cruel prank.
explanation.definitionFit: Satanic means devilish, characteristic of the Devil and so profoundly evil.

clue.text: Hard thing to find on one's foot

definitions.text: Hard thing to find on one's foot

parts.words: Hard thing to find on one's foot
parts.note: surface reading: something difficult to locate, perhaps a blister or splinter
setter's reading: hard describes the substance, a horny growth that is easy to find

explanation.walkthrough: 'Hard to find' suggests difficulty; it is a hard object that anyone can find at the end of a digit.
explanation.definitionFit: Each digit of the foot carries a tough keratin plate on its upper tip.

clue.text: Fellow in charge tending to weaken, often feeling down

parts.note: a fellow is a man
i/c is the abbreviation for in charge
to depress is to weaken or lower, so depressive means tending to do this

explanation.surface: A boss whose spirits keep sinking and who is gradually losing strength.
explanation.walkthrough: The term is an older name for bipolar disorder, in which low moods alternate with high ones, hence 'often' rather than always.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with this condition swings between elation and periods of low mood, so frequently feels low.

clue.text: Number five remains singularly for the month

parts.note: No is the abbreviation for number
V is the Roman numeral five
the remains of a fire are embers; singularly asks for the singular form

explanation.surface: Something about the fifth item being the only one left over for a particular month.
explanation.walkthrough: Bonfire Night, with its glowing embers, falls in this month, a neat hint in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: November is the eleventh month of the year in the calendar.

clue.text: Embarrassed animal is leader of herd!

parts.note: a sheep is a farm animal
taken as written

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its initial letter, so only the first is kept

parts.note: the first letter of herd

explanation.surface: An awkward creature turns out to be the one at the front of the flock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Embarrassed animal' reads as one phrase, but the definition is just the first word.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheepish means looking abashed or bashful through shame, as an awkward person does.

clue.text: Four strip outside junction with small stream

indicators.note: outside places one piece around another, so the strip encloses the number

parts.note: a rule is a straight strip of wood or metal for measuring
IV is the Roman numeral four
a T-junction is where one road meets another at right angles

explanation.surface: A road with four lanes leading to a crossroads near a little brook.
explanation.definitionFit: A rivulet is a very small stream or brook of running water.

clue.text: Chemical paper ignited before problem turned up

parts.note: something ignited has been lit

indicators.note: in a down clue, turned up means read from bottom to top, so backwards

parts.note: a sum is an arithmetic problem

explanation.surface: A chemical paper caught fire before a problem emerged.
explanation.definitionFit: Litmus is a dye on paper strips that changes colour to test whether a solution is acid or alkaline.

clue.text: Fashionable former partner's put on sham woolly

parts.note: what is fashionable is in
an ex is a former partner
a sham is an act, a pretence

explanation.surface: A trendy ex has put on a fake woollen jumper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Woolly' looks like a fabric, but here it means vague or imprecise.
explanation.definitionFit: Woolly thinking is muddled and imprecise, so it lacks exactness and accuracy.

clue.text: Horn, dismantle rear part

indicators.note: part signals that only a portion of the following words is wanted

parts.note: the letters run across the two words

explanation.surface: Instructions to take apart the back section of something.
explanation.definitionFit: Antler is the branched bony growth on a deer's head, loosely called a horn.

clue.text: Actor suspended having been made powerless

parts.note: a ham is an actor who overacts
strung up means hung or suspended

explanation.surface: A performer was banned from working after being rendered helpless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Suspended' suggests a ban from work; it means hung up.
explanation.definitionFit: To be hamstrung is to be crippled or severely hampered, as if the leg tendons were cut.

clue.text: Father puts five pairs on plate

parts.note: pa is a familiar word for father
five twos make ten

explanation.surface: Dad serves ten items, in pairs, onto a dish.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'Father' could suggest a priest, and a paten is indeed the plate a priest uses for bread at the Eucharist.
explanation.definitionFit: A paten is a small plate, usually of silver, used to hold the bread at Communion.

clue.text: Monkey, male's in short grass

indicators.note: in places the male's piece inside the shortened plant
short means cut off at the end, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: a rush is a grasslike marsh plant
he's is a male is

explanation.surface: A male monkey sitting in long grass that has been cut.
explanation.definitionFit: The rhesus macaque is a brown South Asian monkey widely used in medical research.

clue.text: In favour of prose adaptation by Shakespearean

definitions.note: used as a noun: a character from Shakespeare

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: an adaptation changes the original, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone supports turning a play into a prose version by Shakespeare.
explanation.definitionFit: Prospero is the magician and exiled duke at the centre of The Tempest, a Shakespeare play.
